thread:
ACME Integrations: hey team, since we switched to cypress-v1-extended this morning our p99 latency for long-context requests (>= 64k tokens) jumped from ~450ms to 2.1s. This is in production, impact on sync endpoints. can someone triage?
Maya (Support): sorry to hear that — can you share the request IDs / sample payloads? also which endpoint (chat/generate/embeddings)?
ACME Integrations: chat.generate, mostly multi-turn transcripts with large context. example req id: req_2026-03-17_0902_9876. attaching small redacted prompt in a sec.
ACME Integrations: ```
{"model":"cypress-v1-extended","input":"<redacted multi-turn convo>... (65k tokens)","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}
```
Maya (Support): got it, pinging runtime & ml to look at kvcache/ tokenizer interactions. @Ben @Priya @Tom
Ben (SRE): I've pulled the trace for req_2026-03-17_0902_9876 — long tail shows repeated re-encoding and KV cache misses around sequence boundaries. here's a trimmed flamegraph link: https://internal/redwood/traces/req_2026-03-17_0902_9876
Priya (ML): thanks, Ben. cypress-v1-extended onboarding included a change to the tokenizer to prefer larger BPE merges for certain character ranges — that can shift token boundaries and invalidate prefix cache heuristics. did you roll a tokenizer-only artifact?
Tom (Runtime): Yes — we deployed token-merges v3 in the cypress onboarding. Runtime noticed higher prefix mismatch rate causing fallback to full re-tokenize and KV cache rebuilds. p99 will spike if KV cache invalidation occurs mid-request.
ACME Integrations: ahhh — that explains why batched requests are slower too. any recommended immediate mitigations?
Maya (Support): short-term we can route your traffic to cypress-v1-legacy (pre-tokenmerge) for long-context routes — would that be acceptable while we stabilize?
ACME Integrations: that works for now. how do we opt-in?
Maya (Support): I'll request a routing rule: route model=cypress-v1-extended && ctx_tokens>32768 -> cypress-v1-legacy for your org id acme-1234. Ben, can you apply?
Ben (SRE): on it. applying routing rule now. DeployBot: "route update queued -> hostpool-12"
Ben (SRE): rule applied, please validate.
ACME Integrations: sending a couple of requests... p99 for same workload now down to ~480ms. thanks!
Priya (ML): next steps: rollback tokenizer change for the extended variant or ship a compatibility shim that preserves previous tokenization for existing cached prefixes. I'll open a PR for shim (tokenizer-compat v3) to run in parallel.
Tom (Runtime): runtime changes we can do: 1) be more conservative with prefix-match heuristics when model tokenizer version differs, 2) add a delta-encoding path to avoid full KV rebuilds when boundary changes are small, 3) increase kvcache TTL for active sessions to reduce churn. I'll prototype (2) but it's a non-trivial change.
Maya (Support): do we need a coordinated rollback of the token-merges v3 across other customers? any risk of duplicated regressions?
Priya (ML): we rolled token-merges v3 to a small percentage; I didn't expect such a big KV mismatch at 64k+. We should pause the rollout and backfill a fix. I'll mark the rollout paused.
DeployBot: "rollout cypress-tokenizer-v3 -> paused by Priya (ML)"
Ben (SRE): operational mitigations: increased kvcache size on hostpool-12 and temporarily bumped request timeout to accommodate longer rebuilds. Monitoring alert suppressed for acme-1234 during the reroute.
ACME Integrations: appreciate the quick actions. any ETA on full fix so we can go back to the extended model?
Priya (ML): ETA for tokenizer-compat shim: 48 hrs for prototype + validation on long-context corpora. If we need faster, we can rollback token-merges v3 entirely within 2–3 hrs. Which do you prefer?
ACME Integrations: we'll wait for the shim if you think it's safe; otherwise rollback is fine. our traffic can stay on legacy for 24–48 hrs.
Tom (Runtime): decision: pause rollout + keep your traffic routed to legacy. Priya will push shim branch; we'll test on staging with your (redacted) sample set if you can share a few more representative requests (sha256 checksums ok).
Maya (Support): acme, could you upload 3 redacted transcripts (>=64k tokens) to the secure bucket shared earlier? we'll coordinate test window.
ACME Integrations: uploading now (links sent to support DM).
Ben (SRE): one more note: we observed a small fraction (~0.8%) of requests hitting tokenization exception path that forced fallback to CPU re-encoding. I'm opening an incident ticket to track post-mitigation.
Maya (Support): thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with progress; tagging @ACME Integrations once we have the shim staged. :thumbsup:
ACME Integrations: thx team, response time and process here are great. we'll stand by for the shim/rollback decision.
Priya (ML): PR opened: https://git.redwood/pri/pull/542 (tokenizer-compat shim). running long-context evals now, will post perf matrix.
Tom (Runtime): FYI for followup: we should add a preflight test in onboarding that compares tokenization deltas for a held-out long-context corpus to detect KV-churn risks automatically. I'll add an infra ticket.
Ben (SRE): incident ticket: INC-2026-0458 created to track customer impact and mitigation timeline.
Maya (Support): closing loop — routing to legacy is live, rollback paused, PR in flight. will update when shim validated.
ACME Integrations: confirmed, p99 steady at ~470ms. closing on our side unless you want further logs.
Maya (Support): leaving thread open for 48h for validation. thanks everyone!"
